answer: Each identity reaches the jetty only by crossing its own bridge, built plank by plank from its verified jobs — one plank per epoch of real work, never bought or borrowed. At the jetty, peers recompute every plank against the public record before a claim counts, and a plank that does not match drops the claim into the umber, where it sits uncounted and the crossing toll is forfeited. Ten fakes therefore owe ten separate bridges, ten jetty audits, and ten forfeited tolls, and no bridge, audit, or toll can be pooled or reused across clones.
